recentItems.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker - All Romance Options and Best Choices
recentItems.description:
Saving the world in The Blood of Dawnwalker is a heavy burden, but that doesn't mean you can't find a little love along the way. Whether you are drawn to the mysterious witch Anca, the fierce rebellion leader Crake, or the dark and dangerous vrakhiri Lacra, knowing exactly what to say and when to say it is crucial if you want to win their hearts.
This comprehensive gameplay guide breaks down the exact dialogue choices, quest orders, and key interactions needed to unlock every relationship. From navigating Anca's Latin studies and Crake's manumit rebellion to surviving Lacra's deadly trials in Svartrau City, we cover every necessary step. Secure your favorite companion by mastering crucial quests like The Firebrand, Distant Shadows, and The Night of Horrors without missing a single flirting opportunity.

recentItems.title: Kingmakers - Official Gameplay Deep Dive Trailer
recentItems.description:
Join developers Redemption Road for a deep dive into the gameplay of Kingmakers in this latest trailer for the upcoming third-person shooter game. The new video showcases a peek at the map, combat, the story, and RTS mechanics. Kingmakers will be available on PC.

In Kingmakers, go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history, and save the future in this epic action/strategy sandbox. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op for up to four players.

recentItems.title: System Intruder - Official Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description: Get a look at the Announcement Trailer for System Intruder, a retro first-person cyberpunk adventure shooter developed by R_Games. Players will face the sinister secrets of a research complex as Anna. Take stock of text logs, solve puzzles, and traverse the elusive ASGARD-04 complex. System Intruder is coming soon to PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Miniopolis - Official Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description: Here's your look at the Miniopolis announcement trailer for this upcoming resource-free city-building sandbox game, where you can build the way you want. Create, shape, and customize a miniature metropolis with intuitive and satisfying tools. Construct towering cityscapes, fine-tune their look and layout, and give every structure its own distinctive character. Miniopolis will be available on PC (via Steam). A demo is coming soon.

recentItems.title: One Company Connects All of These Games | gamescom 2026
recentItems.description:
Experience Gamescom 2026 through IGN's exclusive coverage of Tencent Games.

Alan Knight is reporting from the show floor and beyond to discover what makes games and developers under the Tencent brand tick. 

From Honor of Kings to Phantom Blade Zero, Zoopunk, Exterminauts, Rust Mobile, Animula Nook, Roco Kingdom, and Worlds of Play, we're checking out Tencent's full scope and giving you everything you need to know, right from the people making these games. 

Presented by Tencent.

recentItems.title: Twitch CEO Expects GTA Online 2 in 2027 - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Twitch CEO Dan Clancy thinkgs GTA 6's grip on gaming culture won't let up even into next year, when he says GTA 6 2 will launch. Via Bloomberg, Clancy said we'll see a "big bump with GTA 6," but also another huge one when multiplayer drops next year. Rockstar has not formally announced their GTA Online plans post-GTA 6, but it's all but inevitable GTA Online continues with GTA 6 as the framework, much like how GTA 5 was the foundation for GTA Online. Parent company Take-Two, for its part, is ready to support the current iteration of GTA Online as long as gamers want to keep playing it. In other news, The Blood of Dawnwalker will get a New Game+ mode eventually, according to the game's director. And Gen-Xers and Millenials rejoice! Toys 'R' Us is making a big retail push this holiday season, opening 120 new standalone stores that will cater to nostalgic adults and today's content creators.

recentItems.title: How Tencent’s relationships with developers work. Presented by @tencentgames4404
Hellraiser Revival: 10 Minutes of New Gameplay
recentItems.description: Clive Barke's Hellraiser Revival just dropped a new demo. Within it is what you can expect from the long running franchise: gruesome horror wrapped in sexual deviance. We go through the opening moments of the game to get to know the protagonist who uses the Lament Configuration to bring about the cenobites to turn his world upside down and send him on a horrific journey to batlte cultists and survive the nightmare.
